title: India Secures Gold in Para Asian Games Badminton
indian_angle: Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra's victory contributed to India's best-ever gold haul at the Para Asian Games.
summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra won the women’s doubles SL3-SU5 title at the Para Asian Games 2026, securing India's 28th gold medal and pushing the nation past 100 medals.

title: Junior Selection Committee Minutes Released
indian_angle: The minutes provide insight into the selection process for India's junior badminton players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India released the minutes from the recent Junior Selection Committee meeting on October 19, 2026.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee aims to give Indian players a stronger voice in the sport's governance.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's top junior talent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence, Guwahati, in preparation for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held
indian_angle: This course enhances the skills of Indian badminton coaches, contributing to player development nationwide.
summary: The BAI Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course was conducted at NCE Guwahati & Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This change in scoring system will impact strategy and play in India's junior domestic badminton circuit.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
